meta.verifiedAgainst: <engine checkout> — re-verify with scripts/check-cutlass-contract.mjs against your runner engine
meta.description: Machine-readable contract between Deal Onboarding and the deal-booking engine (Cutlass MCP tool surface) for CREATE batches. This file is the single source of truth: the frontend contract suite (contractGolden.test.ts) asserts the prompt emission against it, and scripts/check-cutlass-contract.mjs diffs every fact in it against an engine checkout. Facts carrying a note with "asserted-not-extracted" cannot be mechanically verified; the checker lists them as documented residuals instead of silently skipping them.

toolNaming.note: asserted-not-extracted: agent-harness tool naming. The {server} and {tool} halves ARE extracted (mcp/<server>.py file + its @mcp.tool function names); only the composition rule is asserted.

geo.note: Country FULL NAMES (COUNTRY_NAMES map); the MCP alias table resolves 'United States' to the account catalog token 'USA'. zips+dmas merge into dma_codes (both live on the ZipCode key).
geo.usDefault: Operator geo policy (frontend/src/lib/geoPolicy.ts): a deal with no geo INCLUDES is seeded country=US at write time, so every create prompt carries this SSP's geo arg. geoExclude entries do NOT suppress the seed; deals whose SSP (or exclusion shape) is outside the rules.go geo-exclude emission matrix fail the audit closed (geo_exclude_unsupported, #219/#244). The MCPs stay pass-through - no server-side geo default (asserted-not-extracted: Deal Onboarding-side policy).

geoExclude.note: CREATE-side only: the IX create wire is include-only (geo_countries + dma_codes, no region key, no exclusion arg), so Deal Onboarding fails a create-time geo exclusion closed via geo_exclude_unsupported (#219/#244) with a loud builder NOT-SUPPORTED marker, and the geoExcludeEmittingSSPs allowlist in internal/validation/rules.go stays without this SSP. Region is keyed regionCode (targetingKeyID 1067) on every account - live-checked across every configured seat; the old "State" alias matched nothing, so region targeting reached the wire for the first time in cutlass#891. NONE_OF on regionCode is not yet live-canaried.

segmentsExclude.note: Create-time audience segment EXCLUSIONS -> IX NONE_OF segment targeting. Deal Onboarding ALWAYS emits the field (empty [] when none) so trader-entered excludes ride every IX create.

language.note: CREATE-side only: the IX create wire carries no language field (#226), so Deal Onboarding still emits the NOT-SUPPORTED marker and qa_language warns. The UPDATE path CAN set it: ix_merge_deal_language targets the contentLanguage key (targetingKeyID 257, 21 values, English -> "en"), matched exactly with no substring fallback, merge_mode defaulting to replace because "set language to English" is an end state. Added in cutlass#891.

adDuration.note: Allowed-LIST of MAX-duration buckets (seconds -> OpenRTB video.maxduration, ANY_OF). Key + value tokens are account-discovered at runtime; an unmappable duration fails the whole create.

iabExclude.note: Create-time IAB/content-genre EXCLUSIONS -> NONE_OF on the deal's selected key (contentGenre key 11 or iabContentCategory key 1066 - cutlass#831). Values are exact catalog names for THAT key (Deal Onboarding pre-translates through IX_IAB_TO_CONTENT_GENRE / IX_IAB_TO_IAB_CONTENT_CATEGORY + the checked-in 1066 fixture) or verbatim trader-typed genre strings; includes+excludes always land on ONE key (never mixed) and the MCP resolves them exact-match only (cutlass#714), failing the whole create on an unresolvable name.

iabCategories.note: IX targeting key 11 contentGenre is a TV-GENRE taxonomy (94 live values, fixture pulled 2026-07-14 from a live account), NOT IAB; since cutlass#831 the MCP ALSO resolves against the account-discovered key 1066 iabContentCategory (385 IAB-flavored names) - contentGenre first, then iabContentCategory, all-or-nothing per key, NEVER mixed on one deal. Deal Onboarding selects ONE key per deal (ixSelectIabKey) and translates IAB names through the curated catalog-verified IX_IAB_TO_CONTENT_GENRE / IX_IAB_TO_IAB_CONTENT_CATEGORY maps + the checked-in fixtures (unmapped names emit NOT-SUPPORTED comments, never tokens); the MCP resolves each key exact-match only for BOTH includes and excludes - the bidirectional contains-match that silently mis-mapped 'Consumer Banking' to the generic 'Consumer' TV genre is disabled (exactMatchMarker pins the source literal).

pmpDealType.note: cutlass#766: PRIVATE_AUCTION (pmp_deal_type 2) is NOT creatable via the OpenX API - dealCreate's backend validation requires open_auction_access, a field absent from the GraphQL create schema, so every type-2 attempt dies with an opaque INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR (proven live 2026-07-11; every observed live deal was type 3). Cutlass fails closed on create, prepare, AND update with ox_private_auction_unsupported (extracted via failClosedCodes above) and never coerces 2 -> 3. Deal Onboarding side (asserted-not-extracted, pinned by dealPromptYaml.test.ts + rules_test.go): PRIVATE_AUCTION is not offered in the UI, the ox_pmp_type audit rule hard-blocks it, and buildOpenXPrompt emits a line-anchored # BLOCKED marker (the submit gate 422s) instead of the field. Creatable types: PREFERRED_DEAL (3, the default) and PROGRAMMATIC_GUARANTEED (1).

targetingChannel.note: cutlass#726 / #229: the OpenX MCP builds package.targeting.rendering_context (Format / distribution / devices) from targeting.channel and used to default every channel-less brief to DISPLAY (Format=BANNER) — OLV/CTV/OTT deals silently created as banner. Deal Onboarding emits targeting.channel on ALL OpenX deals via channelMap (alwaysEmitted is a Deal Onboarding-side fact, asserted-not-extracted, pinned by contractGolden.test.ts). NATIVE joined the channel enum 2026-08-21 (ad_placement NATIVE is a live enum value — optionsByPath probe): the old fold of Native into DISPLAY relied on the string rendering_context hint to carry the format, but channel-wins in the MCP booked every OpenX Native deal as BANNER. Cutlass-side fail-closed backstops (codes extracted): a video STRING rendering_context without a channel blocks with ox_video_channel_unresolved (a 'native' string now resolves to the NATIVE channel instead), and a channel outside DISPLAY/OLV/CTV/OTT/NATIVE (e.g. the unmapped Audio label, which falls through verbatim) blocks with ox_unknown_channel — never a guessed Format. The string rendering_context line stays emitted for old-MCP back-compat; MCPs from 2026-08-21 upgrade the legacy DISPLAY+native-hint combo to NATIVE.

geo.note: Geo rides INSIDE the targeting dict as targeting.geographic - geo_countries/geo_states keys are silently ignored by the OpenX MCP. Subnational geo is emitted STRUCTURED as {includes:{state:'SK',country:'CA'}} (2-letter codes; the country scopes state-id resolution) - cutlass#724: a flat token like SK is ambiguous between Saskatchewan and Slovakia and the MCP fails closed on it. Country-only deals keep the flat country-NAME list; the MCP validates every country token (ids AND full names) against the live 249-row country option set (optionsByPath deal.package.targeting.geographic.country) and fails closed when the roster is unavailable - no shape-only acceptance.

The MCPs stay pass-through - no server-side geo default (asserted-not-extracted: Deal Onboarding-side policy).

geoExclude.note: #244: Deal Onboarding emits targeting.geographic.excludes — single-country state exclusions as {state, country-hint} and country exclusions (when no state exclusion occupies the branch) as country NAMES; the MCP normalizes + country-resolves the excludes branch symmetrically with includes. Un-emittable shapes (ZIP/DMA excludes, mixed-country or unclassifiable exclude states, country+state excludes together) emit a loud NOT-SUPPORTED marker and the geo_exclude_unsupported audit rule blocks them. Live paused-canary read-back remains the #244 acceptance gate before external release.

segmentsExclude.note: OpenX audience targeting is an include-only {op, val} object with NO excludes branch (live-introspected schema). #226 F2: ox_audience_exclude_unsupported is a HARD BLOCKER (ready_to_create=False), NOT a soft flag that created the deal WITHOUT the exclusion (a create-without silently SERVES the excluded audience). Deal Onboarding never emits the exclude VALUES (they'd hard-fail the MCP) — it emits audience_segments_exclude: [] for recognition + a loud NOT-SUPPORTED marker, and the segment_exclude_unsupported audit rule blocks the (deal, SSP) upstream.

language.note: #226: targeting.languages (inside the create targeting dict - not a def param) -> targeting.technographic.language, resolved via optionsByPath; unresolved values fail closed (unresolved_language). One of the only two SSPs with a create-time language wire.

adDuration.note: Inclusive range (integer seconds) over the ad unit's declared max ad duration -> package.targeting.video.adunit_max_duration_range. End-only defaults start=0 with a warning. Create args are only honored when targeting.channel is one of requiresTargetingChannel (_OX_AD_DURATION_CHANNELS) - the gate NEVER infers the channel from rendering_context or device_type, so the prompt MUST emit channel inside the targeting block whenever adunit_max_duration_* args are present.

grossShareUnit.note: Pinned UNIT CONTRACT (cutlass#743.7 / #234.3): both fee keys are PERCENT 0-100 at the tool boundary; the OpenX Decimal wire is a 0-1 fraction, so accepted values divide by 100 exactly once (_serialize_gross_share_percent). The retired heuristic passed sub-1 inputs through as ALREADY-fraction values - a trader-meant 0.5% silently shipped as a 50% share (100x fee inflation on the money path). Now: legacy gross_share in (0,1) fails closed as unit-ambiguous (invalid_fee_percentage blocker at prepare; ValueError pre-mutation on create/update); the explicit-unit gross_share_percent carries sub-1% shares (0.5 -> wire "0.005"). Deal Onboarding emits gross_share_percent on every PoM fee block.

geo.note: ISO-2 codes; MCP resolves numeric geo ids via /v1/common/geo (countryCode eq US - PubMatic-taxonomy id 232, a DIFFERENT id space from Xandr where 232 is US Minor Outlying Islands).

The MCPs stay pass-through - no server-side geo default (asserted-not-extracted: Deal Onboarding-side policy).

geoExclude.note: #244: create-time geo_countries_exclude / geo_states_exclude resolve through the same geo lookup as the includes and land on targeting excludeGeos (the pm_merge_deal_geo direction='exclude' wire field). Fail-closed: an unresolved exclusion blocks (pm_geo_exclude_unresolved), an include/exclude id overlap blocks (pm_geo_conflict). ZIP/DMA exclusions have no PubMatic path — loud marker + geo_exclude_unsupported audit block. Live paused-canary read-back remains the #244 acceptance gate before external release.

segmentsExclude.note: #226: create-time excluded_segment_names -> targeting excludeAudienceSegments ([{id}] - the pm_merge_deal_segments direction='exclude' wire shape). Fail-closed: unresolved exclusions block (pm_exclude_audience_unresolved), include/exclude overlaps block (pm_segment_conflict).

language.note: asserted-not-extracted (verified by absence): PubMatic has NO language wire anywhere in the create/merge surface (#226). The legacy qa_pm_language 'Language targeting is set' PASS was a false green - Deal Onboarding now emits the NOT-SUPPORTED marker and the SSP-aware qa_language item warns.

adDuration.note: Vendor has no deal-level ad-duration API (curated-deal object + immutable targeting object carry no duration field; verified vs the archived full MBC video-targeting field list, 2026-07-08). Deal Onboarding emits the NOT-SUPPORTED comment + a NOT APPLIED final-summary line; the checker verifies the MCP source has no duration surface.

adFormat.note: Per PubMatic's own catalog (authenticated GET /v1/common/adType, 2026-08-03): 3 Banner/Rich Media, 12 Native, 13 Video; Audio (14) is uiEnabled=0 and stays fail-closed. Supersedes cutlass#754 ('Native has no id' - the catalog endpoint works with a valid token) and cutlass#727's 12->13 'legacy Video alias' rewrite, which cutlass PR #862 REMOVED - 12 was never Video, and the rewrite would silently book a Native deal as Video (the old 'Native (13)' label booked live VIDEO deals the same way). Deal Onboarding offers Banner/Video/Native; the persisted-form 'Video (12)' label still aliases to 13 (those forms MEANT video). Native deals raise pm_native_ad_format, and Cutlass asserts the create/update verification read-back ids against what was submitted (pm_ad_format_readback_mismatch) - the live safety net for the first Native create.

iabCategories.note: #233.4 (mirrors IX #714): the live /v1/common/iabCategories taxonomy (392 QAG entries, 2026-07-09 audit probe) resolves 20/26 IAB_OPTIONS names by exact-normalized match; Deal Onboarding canonicalizes the misses through PUBMATIC_IAB_NAME_CANONICAL ('Law, Gov & Politics' -> "Law, Gov't & Politics" apostrophe variant; 'Careers & Employment' -> 'Careers' QAG tier-1) and emits a loud NOT-SUPPORTED marker for the 4 names with no same-specificity live entry (Auto/Home/Life Insurance, Consumer Banking) instead of a doomed token - the MCP resolver is exact-match fail-closed and an unresolvable name kills the WHOLE create. contractGolden.test.ts pins full IAB_OPTIONS coverage across VERIFIED + CANONICAL + NOT_SUPPORTED (Deal Onboarding-side fact, asserted-not-extracted except the resolver name).

iabExclude.note: Create-time IAB category exclusions -> PubMatic excludeIabCategories (cutlass feat/create-time-iab-excludes). Names or codes, resolved server-side. This fact drifts against cutlass@dev until that branch merges - land the cutlass side first. Only IX + PubMatic take create-time excludes; the other five SSPs surface exclusions as trader-UI follow-ups (Deal Onboarding-side, asserted by contractGolden.test.ts) and carry no iabExclude block.

owner.note: Owner lives ONLY in the Cutlass variant env (PUBMATIC_OWNER_ID, no built-in default). Deal Onboarding emits the falsy sentinel 0 for logged_in_owner_id (the MCP resolves it to the configured owner) and the role only (type 7 = Buyer). A literal owner id must never appear in a prompt - it comes from the engine env.

dates.sourceMarker: interpreted as UTC by the Deal Service
dates.note: cutlass#744.8: Deal Service naive datetimes ('YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS') are stored/interpreted as UTC - live-verified against 100-deal read-backs (UI-picked midnight-ET starts read back 04:00:00/05:00:00); the protocol's old 'local time' claim was wrong and is corrected in deal-creation-xandr.yaml + the update tool docstring (sourceMarker pins the corrected docstring). Deal Onboarding emits the intended ET-calendar-day start as its UTC instant (businessMidnightUtc - midnight America/New_York) and OMITS start_date for a today-start (the MCP defaults to now = immediate), so a deal never goes live the prior evening ET.

buyer.note: #231 / cutlass#734. Deal Onboarding emits NUMERIC buyer member ids from XANDR_BUYER_CANONICAL where a house buyer member exists (houseBuyerMembers is asserted-not-extracted: live-probed via GET /platform-member primary_type=buyer, 2026-07-09 audit); numeric skips the MCP's name resolution (numericEscapeHatchMarker pins the docstring). DV360/Amazon have NO house buyer member - those deals route by the trader's NUMERIC seat id. Anything else emits the name; the MCP resolves it via /platform-member and fails loud on ambiguity (never fuzzy-guessed over the ~16k-row directory).

geo.note: ISO-2 codes; MCP resolves via GET /country?code_like= onto the PROFILE as country_targets [{id:233,name:'United States'}] + country_action=include. 233, never 232 (US Minor Outlying Islands - silently resolves 0 regions).

The MCPs stay pass-through - no server-side geo default (asserted-not-extracted: Deal Onboarding-side policy).

environment.note: Inventory Type. Curate DOES carry an environment axis, contrary to the pre-2026-08-31 assumption that had Deal Onboarding drop it with a NOT-SUPPORTED marker. It rides the PROFILE as supply_type_targets + supply_type_action='include', alongside device_type_targets. Wire values are live-verified against 36 of 100 profiles on the account (2026-08-31): the canonical AppNexus docs say 'mobile_browser', the wire says 'mobile_web' - trust the wire. Deal Onboarding emits In-App -> [mobile_app], Web Only -> [web, mobile_web], and NOTHING for All (an absent restriction is already the widest). An unrecognized value is dropped MCP-side with xandr_unresolved_supply_type rather than narrowing the deal on a guess.

geoExclude.note: #244: create-time geo_countries_exclude / geo_states_exclude set the profile's country_action / region_action siblings to 'exclude' — the same fields the merge tool drives. One action per dimension: an include+exclude mix on the same dimension fails closed BEFORE any network call (xandr_geo_country_conflict / xandr_geo_region_conflict); the canonical compose (include country, exclude region) works. Unresolved exclusions abort the create (xandr_geo_exclude_unresolved) — never partial-dropped. Deal Onboarding emits an exclusion only when its dimension carries no includes; ZIP/DMA excludes have no Xandr path (loud marker + audit block). Live paused-canary read-back remains the #244 acceptance gate before external release.

segmentsExclude.note: #226: create-time excluded_segment_names -> segment_targets elements with action='exclude' (the merge tool's element shape). Fail-closed: unresolved exclusions abort before the deal POST (xandr_segment_exclude_unresolved); include/exclude overlaps abort (xandr_segment_conflict).

viewability.note: asserted-not-extracted (verified by absence): no viewability field anywhere on the Xandr create wire - deal, profile, or curated line item (#226). Deal Onboarding emits the NOT-SUPPORTED marker; qa_viewability warns instead of the old false-green PASS.

language.note: asserted-not-extracted (verified by absence): no create-time language wire (#226) - NOT-SUPPORTED marker + qa_language warn.

adDuration.note: Single scalar, integer seconds, LOWER bound only (targets slots allowing >= N seconds) riding the deal line-item's profile.video_targets. Cannot cap length upward - Deal Onboarding maps allowed lists to min(list) with a loud comment and reports max-only caps as NOT APPLIED.

lists.note: No list-FILE ingestion path (#220): profile deal-list targeting (xandr_merge_deal_lists) takes PRE-EXISTING Curate deal-list names/ids only, and raw publisher_targets are platform-prohibited on Curate profiles. Deal Onboarding emits a loud '# LIST NOT APPLIED' comment + a Required-final-summary disclosure line instead of any file arg; the deal card and qa_list_ssp_support surface the same. supported:false itself is asserted-not-extracted (verified by absence — no @mcp.tool in xandr_mcp.py ingests a values_file into domain/app-bundle targeting).

whitelistedSeats.note: #234.4: the Select v9.4 whitelisted_seats surface is a list of PER-DEMAND-PARTNER seat groups {'demand_partner': <name>, 'seat_ids': [<id>, ...]} (Guide p.20/p.25-26). A flat 'seat_id' field does not exist - the retired merge helper keyed identity on it, making per-partner merges impossible and duplicate partner entries possible. Identity is now demand_partner (case/space-normalized); 'add' unions seat_ids per partner; entries carrying the phantom seat_id key FAIL CLOSED at create (mn_whitelisted_seats_invalid) and at the merge tool. Deal Onboarding does NOT emit whitelisted_seats - Media.net seat-level buyer scoping stays NOT-SUPPORTED (write acceptance vendor-unverified, cutlass#755); deals route at DSP level via demand_partners.

domainsMerge.note: Publisher-domain INVENTORY targeting: deal-body object publisher_domains {values, is_excluded} (Select API Guide v9.4 p.26). advertiserWhitelistTool (medianet_merge_deal_domains) writes ONLY the flat advertiser whitelist whitelisted_domains and hard-fails on target:/is_excluded: args - it is never a substitute for inventory targeting. App-bundle lists are UNSUPPORTED on Media.net (app_categories are category ids, not bundles) and must emit unsupported_targeting_op.

geo.note: ISO-2 codes; MCP resolves each to {geo_type:'country',id:'US',is_excluded:false}. The real v9 field is 'geo' - legacy 'geos' string lists are a documented trap with no transform.

The MCPs stay pass-through - no server-side geo default (asserted-not-extracted: Deal Onboarding-side policy).

NOT emitted by Deal Onboarding — the builder emits a loud NOT-SUPPORTED marker and the geo_exclude_unsupported audit rule blocks the batch (#219/#244 fail-closed).

segmentsExclude.note: asserted-not-extracted (verified by absence of an exclude direction): all four Media.net segment groups (first_party/experian_custom/experian_syndicated/contextual) are include-only on create AND merge - the Select API has no audience-exclusion surface (#226). NOT-SUPPORTED marker + qa_segment_excludes warn.

language.note: #226: device_languages resolved against the device-languages entity catalog (unresolved values raise the dynamic <kind>_unresolved blocker - fail-closed). One of the only two SSPs with a create-time language wire.

adDuration.note: Deal-body video:{min,max} - PRESUMED ad-duration bounds in integer seconds; the Select API guide is partner-gated so units/direction are unverified. Every Deal Onboarding emission carries the UNVERIFIED warning comment.

geo.note: No flat geo param - the prompt instructs Step 1b (tl_list_countries) to resolve names to member-scoped INTEGER ids, then passes payload.country_ids. Load-bearing: tl_create_deal hard-requires a targetingExpression, so the US default keeps geo-less+segment-less TL deals creatable.

The MCPs stay pass-through - no server-side geo default (asserted-not-extracted: Deal Onboarding-side policy).

subnationalGeo.note: cutlass#732: tl_create_deal folds the region_ids/postal_codes payload keys into targetingExpression (EB_SUPPLY_GEO_REGION_ID integralTargets / EB_SUPPLY_GEO_CANONICAL_POSTAL_CODE stringTargets — both leaves live-read-proven on deals 85567/85579); tl_list_regions resolves state/province names to ids. Deal Onboarding emits region_ids for r.states (resolve-first, fail-loud on an unresolvable state). zipsEmitted:false is the fail-closed interim: postal WRITE acceptance is vendor-unconfirmed until the live create canary runs, so the TL prompt emits a NOT-SUPPORTED manual-step block for ZIPs instead of the key (flip zipsEmitted + the builder together after the canary). dmasEmitted:false is permanent-until-vendor: no DMA binding exists. statesEmitted/zipsEmitted/dmasEmitted are Deal Onboarding-side facts (asserted-not-extracted), pinned by contractGolden.test.ts.

geoExclude.note: targetingExpression nodes carry an 'excluded' bool (the sourceMarker literal), but _build_targeting_expression never sets it on EB_SUPPLY_GEO_COUNTRY_ID nodes and whether the TL engine honors excluded:true on supply-geo nodes is vendor-unconfirmed. NOT emitted by Deal Onboarding — the builder emits a loud NOT-SUPPORTED marker and the geo_exclude_unsupported audit rule blocks the batch (#219/#244 fail-closed indefinitely).

segmentsExclude.note: The targetingExpression format carries an excluded bool, but whether the TL engine honors excluded:true on EB_SUPPLY_1P_SEGMENT_ID audience leaves is vendor-unconfirmed (cutlass#757) - ambiguous capability = NOT SUPPORTED: loud marker, never an unverified exclude leaf (#226).

language.note: asserted-not-extracted (verified by absence): no create-time language wire (#226) - NOT-SUPPORTED marker + qa_language warn.

iabCategories.note: VENDOR-GATED (#226 item C): tl_create_deal has no IAB path - the brandAndCreativeControls iabCategoryTargeting scaffold ships EMPTY and TripleLift publishes no IAB item-ID discovery endpoint (cutlass#757 ask #4). Deal Onboarding emits the loud NOT-SUPPORTED marker; qa_contextual warns so TL IAB can never report configured.

adDuration.note: Vendor has no deal-level ad-duration mechanism (live-probed 2026-07-08 on a live member: legacyTargeting duration fields are read-only null projections; every duration-shaped targetingExpression binding candidate rejected VALIDATION_ERROR). Deal Onboarding emits the NOT-SUPPORTED comment + a NOT APPLIED final-summary line; the checker verifies the MCP source has no duration surface. Re-verified 2026-08-21: cutlass eb669850 added CREATIVE_DURATION to the advertiserReport reporting columns - a report dimension (creative length), not a create/update targeting surface; pinned in knownNonTargetingMentions so the absence check scrubs it and any NEW duration mention still drifts.

lists.dimension: targetingExpression EB_SUPPLY_DOMAIN_ID leaf (supply-domain/site inventory; bare-domain stringTargets, excluded:true = blocklist) — NOT advertiser/adomain brand-safety
lists.note: #220/cutlass#731: tl_create_deal takes no list file, so Deal Onboarding instructs a POST-CREATE tl_merge_deal_supply_domains merge for domain lists — the SUPPLY-domain (site/inventory) targetingExpression leaf a site list actually means. tl_merge_deal_domains remains the separate ADVERTISER-domain (adomain brand-safety) control (advertiserDimensionMarker pins its docstring) and is never a substitute. App-bundle lists have no TripleLift dimension at all and emit LIST NOT APPLIED. supplyDomainsSupported:true is asserted-not-extracted with one open residual: the EB_SUPPLY_DOMAIN_ID encoding is live-read-proven (on live deals) and the tool ships, but WRITE acceptance of the binding awaits the one live canary PATCH on a paused deal (cutlass#731 release gate; if rejected, cutlass flips the protocol domains row to unsupported and this repoints back).

buyer.requiredMarker: buyers is required (at least one buyer per DSP)
buyer.note: ClearLine takes dsps[i].buyers as a LIST and resolves each ref independently against that DSP's full (paginated) buyer catalog, so ONE deal can be pinned to many buyer seats. Deal Onboarding splits a comma-separated Seat ID into one entry per seat (splitSeatIds, frontend/src/lib/seatPolicy.ts) and the seat_multi audit rule confines a multi-seat value to Magnite-only batches, since every other SSP carries a single seat token and would ship the comma list verbatim. listMarker pins the per-ref resolution loop: were buyers ever narrowed to a scalar, the multi-seat wire would silently book only the first buyer. ANY unresolved ref blocks the whole create (buyer_unresolved) - no deal books with a partial buyer list.

geo.note: ISO-2 codes resolved per source against metadata/countries (SpringServe values ARE ISO codes; DV+ values are numeric with plain-name labels). State/province targeting rides geo_regions_include, resolved against metadata/regions — those tokens ALSO differ by source (Quebec is CA-QC on SpringServe, 1412 on DV+) so they are always catalog-resolved, never hardcoded. geography.country and geography.region are INDEPENDENT components that each carry a single Include XOR Exclude type; they compose on one deal. metroArea/city/postalCode remain unwired.

The MCPs stay pass-through - no server-side geo default (asserted-not-extracted: Deal Onboarding-side policy).

geoExclude.note: #244: country and region are INDEPENDENT geography components, each carrying a single Include XOR Exclude type. Deal Onboarding emits geo_countries_exclude only when the deal has no country includes, and geo_regions_exclude only when it has no state includes (geo_country_conflict / geo_region_conflict blockers); an exclusion alongside a same-component include emits a loud NOT-SUPPORTED marker and geo_exclude_unsupported blocks it. ACROSS components they compose: a country include plus a region exclude ("target Canada, exclude Quebec") is one valid payload. Region Exclude is LIVE-VERIFIED — 2026-08-28 canary on MGNI-MD-449-34286 (Outcomes CA, DV+ marketplace 449) wrote geography.region type Exclude via the DMG PUT and read it back with every sibling component byte-identical. ZIP/DMA exclusions still have no Magnite exclude surface — loud marker + audit block.

segmentsExclude.note: SpringServe (Streaming: CTV + OTT) ONLY - DV+ has no audience API until Magnite v3.0 (audience_segments_unsupported_on_dvplus), so DV+ exclusions ride the manual post-create comment and qa_segment_excludes warns (#226).

viewability.note: No viewability create arg on the Magnite MCP. DV+ deals get the raw-targeting viewability MANUAL comment (min deciles 0-90); SpringServe (Streaming: CTV + OTT) has NO verified viewability surface - the builder emits the NOT-SUPPORTED marker (the pre-fix CTV path emitted NOTHING while qa_viewability reported PASS; #226).

language.note: CREATE-side only: there is no language arg on the ClearLine create wire (#226), so the builder still emits the NOT-SUPPORTED marker and qa_language warns. Do NOT read that as "Magnite cannot target language": the UPDATE path can, via magnite_merge_language -> targeting.device.language (languages_include/languages_exclude, single Include XOR Exclude type, merge_mode defaults to replace). That component is absent from Magnite's own published spec (OpenAPI v1.12.0 documents targeting.platform with device/os/brand/browser and no language; the PDF guide never mentions it) but IS on the live wire - LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-08-28 on MGNI-MD-449-34286: the tool wrote device.language Include [en] and geography (Canada Include + Quebec Exclude) plus domainList survived byte-identical. Values resolve against a pinned ISO 639-1 set because Magnite publishes no language metadata endpoint. Exclude direction is supported by the tool but NOT yet live-canaried.

iabCategories.note: asserted-not-extracted (verified by absence): the ClearLine Curation Demand Management API has no content-category/IAB surface (zero iab/content-category references in the Magnite MCP) - Deal Onboarding emits the loud NOT-SUPPORTED marker; qa_contextual warns (#226).

adDuration.note: targeting.video.adDuration {min:int, max:int|null}, integer seconds, contiguous range, BOTH sources (SpringServe CTV + DV+). max without min fails closed - the MCP documents ad_duration_min=1 as the 'up to N seconds' convention, which Deal Onboarding emits for max-only briefs. Range-mapping a discrete list widens it (surfaced by a prompt comment).

mrwm.note: 'Market Rate with Minimum' is DV+-only: SpringServe (Streaming: CTV + OTT) creates block at cutlass prepare, so buildMagnitePrompt downgrades Streaming deals to Market Rate (#228). On DV+ the floor ships as the TOP-LEVEL curatorPricing.minimumCpm (cutlass#718) and MRwM without a floor blocks (mrwm_minimum_missing) - Deal Onboarding always emits a floor with MRwM.

finalStep.note: Every arg buildBatchPrompt's final_step block instructs is a REAL build_deal_sheet parameter (#236.1 — the block used to emit phantom partner:/campaign_id: args the tool never accepted). The campaign_id intent now rides output_filename (campaign-id-prefixed sheet filename). contractGolden.test.ts pins Deal Onboarding's emission to this arg set; check-cutlass-contract.mjs pins each arg against the cutlass tool signature.
